remarks: Welcome to your new home in the picturesque and vibrant gated community of Chesterfield! This charming 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhome is ideally situated within a short distance of Ridgeway Center, Downtown Stamford, and Bulls Head shopping centers. As you enter, you'll be greeted by an inviting main level featuring a vaulted ceiling, hardwood floors, and a stylish kitchen island. The main floor includes a bedroom that opens to a lovely private balcony, accompanied by a full bathroom accessible from both the bedroom and the living area. Venture upstairs to discover a versatile open loft with skylights, perfect for a home office, workout area, or whatever suits your lifestyle. The spacious primary bedroom boasts an en-suite bathroom complete with a soaking tub, separate shower, double vanity, and a walk-in closet with pull-down attic access for extra storage. Additional highlights include an assigned garage space, community pool access, and plenty of parking for you and your guests. Enjoy the convenience of laundry facilities located in the loft area. Don't miss out on this fantastic rental opportunity! 700+ Credit Score Required.
